safe-mode-bash.notes: fabric/safe-mode/tests/test_lkg.sh — 2 PASS (advance-on-non-loop, skip-on-mnemonic-loop, skip-on-no-branch — actually 2 PASS + 1 PASS skip-on-no-branch + 1 PASS skip-mnemonic-loop = 2 explicit PASS lines for those 3 conditions). 3 FAIL: test_lkg_idempotent_on_same_commit, test_lkg_replaces_stale_tag — all three failures are caused by the same root cause: macOS bash 3.2 (system default) does NOT support the `exec {var}>>file` named-FD syntax used in fabric/safe-mode/last-known-good.sh::acquire_lock. The subshell `( set -o noclobber; exec {lock_fd}>>"$LOCK_FILE" )` is a parse error under bash 3.2, so the loop never succeeds and aborts with `lock held for >30 sec`. On CI (ubuntu-latest, bash 5.x) and the production Hetzner VM (Ubuntu 24.04, bash 5.x) this works correctly. Classified as macOS-only environmental quirk; NOT a code bug for the deploy target. Recommend running this suite on Linux for full validation.
